props.title: The Year Open Source Started Closing Its Doors

props.text: Six major open-source projects — including Jazzband, Ladybird, curl, and tldraw — closed their doors to external pull requests in 2026 as AI-generated spam overwhelmed maintainers.

Meanwhile, GitHub shipped the Copilot coding agent for autonomous PR generation. MiroShark inverts the entire dynamic: an AI agent has maintained the project for 140+ days, filing 53 self-improvement PRs, while 298 human forks contributed almost nothing.

props.message: The slopocalypse did not break open source — it revealed that the maintenance model was already broken.
